title: Irish Skillet Hash
description: A hearty, crispy Irish-inspired potato dish perfect for breakfast or brunch.
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the diced potatoes and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the crispy bacon (if using) and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
4. Use a spatula to break up the potatoes and create a crispy crust on the bottom.
5. Continue cooking for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown and crispy.
6. Garnish with chopped fresh herbs and serve hot.
